eval.description: OpenAI internal computer-use evals that check whether the model asks for confirmation before high-risk actions under platform and developer confirmation policy. Categories are financial transaction, high-stakes communication, and general confirmation. Scored as confirmation-policy adherence / compliance rate. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Checks if AI agents ask the user to confirm before they take high-risk actions.

links.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card (User Confirmations During Computer Use)

versions.changes: OpenAI reports an improved user-confirmations evaluation for computer use in the GPT-5.4 Thinking card. Policies and datasets may evolve.

scores.description: The model follows the confirmation policy for that high-risk action category.

metrics.description: Share of cases where the model adheres to the confirmation policy. Higher is better. Per category.
